summary.text: Christine Cockley is a Democratic state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 6 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. An executive assistant at YWCA Columbus when she ran in 2024, she holds two degrees from The Ohio State University.

paragraphs.text: Cockley was born in Mansfield, Ohio, graduated from Lexington High School, and earned a B.A. and an M.P.A. from The Ohio State University.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she worked for YWCA Columbus as executive assistant to its president and CEO, had previously worked in human resources, campaigns and government, and served on the board of Highland Youth Garden.
Cockley defeated Hussein Jabiri in the November 2024 general election for District 6.
In the 2025–2026 session she was assigned to the Agriculture, Insurance, and Technology and Innovation committees.

In the 2024 survey, her stated priorities included preventative health care, expanding Medicaid and Medicare coverage, a higher minimum wage, affordable childcare, and clean drinking water and clean energy.
